outlook.statement: The Board believes that retaining earnings at this stage will support the Company's long-term growth strategy, strengthen operational and financial resilience, and create sustainable value for shareholders.

The Company's international business will continue to focus on semi-regulated markets and SPOT tender opportunities to support sustainable and profitable growth. Key strategic priorities include expanding product registrations across priority international markets, building a differentiated and diversified product portfolio with strategic focus on Beta-lactam segment, strengthening long-term strategic partnerships, enhancing regulatory capabilities, and evaluating strategic opportunities to expand manufacturing capabilities through organic and selective inorganic initiatives.

The Indian pharmaceutical industry is expected to maintain a healthy growth trajectory over the medium to long term, with industry estimates indicating the overall market could expand to approximately US$200 billion by 2030.
The Company expects to receive GMP approvals from regulatory authorities of Rwanda and Sudan during FY 2026-27, subject to completion of regulatory review process.

The Company intends to pursue additional product registrations in markets including Nigeria, Sudan, Bolivia, Ecuador, Kosovo, Syria, Myanmar, the Dominican Republic, El Salvador, Kenya, Rwanda, and other semi-regulated markets, subject to regulatory approvals and commercial feasibility.

risks: At present, in the opinion of the Board of Directors, there are no risks which may threaten the existence of the Company.
Drug Price Control - Government may bring more drugs under price control or change ceiling price calculation mechanism
Generics - Government policies shifting market towards generic products may impact future business strategies
Manufacturing & Supplying Risk - Disruption at in-house facilities or supplier locations due to economic, political & social factors
Quality deficiencies in products from suppliers impacting financial performance
New capital investments - Product registration processes in various countries take time
Currency fluctuation risks from overseas operations and financing activities
International Taxation - Potential tax exposure from varying laws and interpretations across jurisdictions
Global Shortage of API - Lack of raw materials and APIs generating challenges in manufacturing
Regulatory compliance risks - Stringent regulations with severe penalties for non-compliance
Human capital risk - Loss of key personnel, timely replenishment of critical vacant roles
Reliance on third party sole suppliers or service providers including regional suppliers
Disruption of operations from natural disasters
Risk arising out of strategic projects
Changing landscape of statutory regime
Foreign exchange fluctuations
Evolving regulatory requirements across key export destinations
Pricing pressure in global generic medicines market
Geopolitical developments
Potential changes in international trade policies
The Company has no significant Commodity price risk or Foreign exchange risk. The Company has not undertaken any hedging activities for commodity price risk and foreign exchange risk.
